featured_reviews.name: SP Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Meera Jewellers, located in Bhayander, is a well-known jewellery store that truly stands out for its beautiful and unique collection. The moment you step into the shop, you are greeted with an impressive range of designs that cater to different tastes and preferences. What particularly caught my attention was their exclusive East Indian Catholic jewellery collection. The craftsmanship and detailing in these traditional designs are simply amazing and not very easy to find elsewhere.

One of the highlights of Meera Jewellers is their lightweight jewellery options. I was genuinely amazed to see their 5-gram necklace sets, which are not only elegant but also perfect for those who prefer subtle yet classy designs. These sets are ideal for daily wear as well as small occasions, making them a great choice for modern customers who value both style and comfort.

For anyone looking for good designs with a traditional touch, Meera Jewellers is definitely worth a visit. The variety available ensures that you can find something suitable whether you are shopping for yourself or buying a gift for a special occasion.

The making charges start at 10%, which is slightly on the higher side, but this is balanced by the quality, finish, and uniqueness of the designs they offer. Apart from this, the overall collection is quite impressive and thoughtfully curated.

Please note that the shop remains closed on Mondays, and on other days they do not operate between 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm due to their lunch break. Overall, Meera Jewellers is a reliable destination for elegant and distinctive jewellery in Bhayander.
